name: @ai-ecoverse/sliccy-browser
description: sliccy:browser for jsh, over CDP. Discovers Chrome via SLICC_CDP_URL, slicc browsers --json, DevToolsActivePort under slicc profiles (live /json/version must match the file's websocket path), then 127.0.0.1:9222. Discovered endpoints refuse seven/vault/extension/error pages.
